body: Joanna, this is going to be such a beautiful week.

Athens, Mykonos, Paros, Santorini — four very different islands strung together over seven days, with the kind of pace that lets you actually breathe between them. A whitewashed start in Plaka, two nights tucked into a private villa above Psarou, an organic farm lunch on Paros, and the caldera of Oia as a finale.

La Divina is your home in Athens — a 12-suite neoclassical hideaway dedicated to Maria Callas, with views straight to the Acropolis. From there, a quick flight to Mykonos and your private villa. Ferries handle the island hops to Paros and Santorini, with private vans waiting at every port and airport, every single day.

Lunches and dinners are pre-arranged at the spots worth pre-arranging — the Cook & Feast chef night at the Mykonos villa, the farm tasting on Paros, the wine tour through Santorini's volcanic vineyards, the farewell at Pacman as the sun sets over the caldera. The mornings are mostly yours to slow down with.

The rhythm is intentional: two nights in the islands you'll want to linger in, one night where one is enough. Transfers are confirmed door-to-door, ferries are booked, and every property is expecting you.

If anything shifts on the ground — a ferry running late, a restaurant closing early, a beach club you'd rather skip — your local concierge and I are both a text away. The whole point is that you don't have to think about logistics.

kbyg.title: Greece
kbyg.sub: A few practical notes for your week across Athens and the Cyclades — currency, ferries, tipping, and the rest of the small things that make travel feel easy.

topics.label: Passport & Entry
topics.head: Valid passport required
topics.body: Greece is a Schengen Area country. US citizens do not need a visa for stays under 90 days, and the new ETIAS authorization launches in 2026 — apply online before you fly. Make sure your passport is valid for at least three months beyond your return date.

topics.label: Currency & Payments
topics.head: Euro is official
topics.body: Major credit cards are accepted at hotels and most restaurants. Smaller tavernas and island shops often prefer cash. ATMs are easy to find in Athens and on every island. A small euro float is useful for taxis and tips.

topics.label: Tipping
topics.head: Modest, appreciated, never expected
topics.body: Service is typically included on the bill. An extra 5–10% in cash for excellent service is gracious. €1–2 per drink at bars; €5–10 for porters and drivers; €10+ for outstanding concierge help.

topics.label: Language
topics.head: Greek, with English everywhere in tourism
topics.body: Greek is the official language; English is universal at hotels, restaurants, and the islands' tourist core. A kalimera (good morning) and efcharistó (thank you) are warmly received.

topics.label: Time & Weather
topics.head: EEST · warm, dry, breezy in mid-May
topics.body: Eastern European Summer Time (UTC+3) — seven hours ahead of US Eastern. Mid-May runs 68–78°F with sunshine and the Aegean's signature meltemi breeze on the islands. Pack layers for evenings and cooler ferry decks.

topics.label: Power & Plugs
topics.head: 230V · European Type C / F
topics.body: Two-prong European outlets, same as Continental Europe. Most modern phone and laptop chargers handle 230V automatically. Bring one or two adapters for hair tools and anything single-voltage.

topics.label: Connectivity
topics.head: Strong coverage on every island
topics.body: T-Mobile, AT&T, and Verizon all offer competitive international plans for Greece. Wi-Fi is standard at every hotel and most cafés. Download offline Google Maps before you leave — it's faster than relying on signal in the village alleys.

topics.label: Ferries & Inter-Island Travel
topics.head: Show up 45 minutes early
topics.body: Your ferries between Mykonos, Paros, and Santorini are pre-booked on Seajets — fast, comfortable catamarans that handle the route in under an hour. Ports are small and unfussy; arrive 45 minutes ahead, your driver will help with luggage. Crossings can be choppy in heavy meltemi weeks; bring a Bonine if you're sensitive.

overview.title: At a Glance
overview.summary_line: 6 nights · May 11 — 17, 2026 · Athens, Mykonos, Paros, Santorini

days.title: Welcome to Athens
days.subtitle: Arrival · the Acropolis at golden hour · sunset dinner on the Riviera
days.overview_summary: Arrive ATH · Wine & Tales beneath the Parthenon · Check-in at La Divina · Dinner at Astir Four Seasons

items.title: Arrive Athens International (ATH)
items.body: Touch down at Eleftherios Venizelos. A driver from your private transfer service will be waiting in arrivals to escort you and your luggage to the car.

items.title: Private transfer · Airport to La Divina
items.body: Roughly 45 minutes into central Athens, depending on traffic. Your driver speaks English and knows the city.

items.title: Wine & Tales Beneath the Parthenon
items.body: A licensed private guide leads you up to the Acropolis and the Parthenon, then through the Acropolis Museum, finishing with a wine tasting in a beautifully curated bar in Plaka. Greek wines, traditional bites, and the kind of stories the audio guides skip.
items.meta: Included: state-licensed guide, Acropolis & museum entries, tasting · Not included: lunch, transport between stops

items.title: Check-in at La Divina
items.body: Your bags are waiting. La Divina's 12 suites sit in a neoclassical mansion once dedicated to Maria Callas, with Acropolis views from the rooftop. Settle in whenever you finish at the museum.

items.title: Transfer to the Athenian Riviera
items.body: Your driver collects you from La Divina for the 30-minute drive south down the coast to Vouliagmeni.

items.title: Dinner at Astir Four Seasons
items.body: Dinner on the property at one of the Four Seasons' beachside restaurants, with a quick tour of the legendary peninsula resort if you're up for it. Sunset on the Aegean from arguably the best stretch of the Riviera.

days.title: Athens to Mykonos
days.subtitle: Quick island flight · Katikies arrival · a private chef night at the villa
days.overview_summary: Flight ATH → JMK · Katikies Mykonos lunch · Check-in at Psarou Delight Villa · Cook & Feast in Style chef dinner

items.title: Check-out at La Divina
items.body: Settle any incidentals at the front desk. Your driver will be waiting outside at 11:00.

items.title: Private transfer · La Divina to ATH
items.body: Direct to the airport, roughly 45 minutes. Domestic terminal.

items.title: Flight ATH → JMK
items.body: Aegean / Sky Express short hop to Mykonos. Forty minutes in the air; arrive 2:10 PM.
items.meta: Flight time: 40 min · Carry-on plus one checked bag

items.title: Welcome to Mykonos
items.body: Your private van and driver will meet you at arrivals. They'll handle luggage and stay with you for the duration of your time on the island.

items.title: Lunch at Katikies Mykonos
items.body: An afternoon at one of Mykonos's most beautifully designed sea-view properties — finger food, cocktails, and a tour of the suites if you'd like one. A gentle entry to the island.

items.title: Check-in at Psarou Delight Villa
items.body: Your home for the next two nights. Private pool, sea views, dedicated concierge from BlueVillas, and a butler available for anything you need.
items.meta: 2 nights · Tue, May 12 — Thu, May 14 · BlueVillas concierge handles arrivals and any in-villa requests

items.title: Cook & Feast in Style — private chef dinner
items.body: A private chef arrives at the villa for a hands-on Greek cooking class and four-course dinner on the veranda overlooking the Aegean. Batzina (zucchini-feta pie), Mykonos Mostra salad, papoutsakia, and orange cake — paired with local wine. Casual, social, exactly the right first night.
items.meta: Included: chef, all ingredients, full menu, wine pairings

days.title: Mykonos Town & the Beach Club Circuit
days.subtitle: Whitewashed alleys at golden hour · Nammos · Scorpios · dinner at Buddha Bar
days.overview_summary: Mykonos Town walking tour · Souvlaki lunch · Nammos & Scorpios · Dinner at Santa Marina's Buddha Bar

items.title: Town Walkabout
items.body: An English-speaking local guide walks you through Chora's whitewashed maze — the old port, Paraportiani Church, Matoyianni Street, and Little Venice with its iconic windmills. Camera-ready around every corner.
items.meta: Driver waits nearby; meet back at a fixed point when you finish

items.title: Souvlaki lunch
items.body: A casual, classic Greek lunch in the heart of Chora — the antidote to the white-tablecloth scene. Authentic, fast, exactly what you want at midday.

items.title: Transfer back to the villa
items.body: Fifteen minutes to the villa for an afternoon at the pool — or skip it and head straight on if you'd rather.

items.title: Drinks at Nammos
items.body: The Mykonos beach club, full stop. Walk the dunes, grab a cocktail, see the scene.

items.title: Cocktails at Scorpios
items.body: The other half of the Mykonos beach club ritual. Sunset DJ sets, bohemian-luxe interiors, the kind of place that's better at the front end of the night than the back.

items.title: Dinner at Buddha Bar · Santa Marina
items.body: Dinner at the Santa Marina resort's Buddha Bar, with a quick property look if you'd like one. Pan-Asian menu, sweeping bay views, and the most reliably beautiful sunset spot on the island.

days.title: Mykonos to Paros
days.subtitle: An hour by ferry · organic farm tasting in Naoussa · dinner at Avant Mar
days.overview_summary: Ferry JMK → PAS · Organic Farm Tour & Lunch in Naoussa · Check-in at Avant Mar · Matsuhisa-led dinner

items.title: Check-out at Psarou Delight Villa
items.body: BlueVillas concierge confirms anything outstanding. Driver loads bags.

items.title: Transfer to Mykonos Port (Tourlos)
items.body: Fifteen minutes to the port. Your driver hands you off to the Seajets ground team.

items.title: Ferry Mykonos → Paros
items.body: High-speed catamaran, roughly one hour, comfortable assigned seating. Light snacks aboard. Arrive Parikia (Paros Port) at 1:25 PM.
items.meta: Booking confirmed · Show up 45 minutes early

items.title: Welcome to Paros
items.body: A new private van and driver greet you at the port. They stay with you across both Paros and (transferred to a Santorini partner) the next day.

items.title: Organic Farm Tour & Lunch
items.body: A working organic farm overlooking Naoussa Bay. Wander the rows of grapes, olives, capers, oregano, pomegranates, figs — meet the chickens and goats, then sit down on the balcony for a tasting menu drawn entirely from what you've just walked past. Wine and water included.
items.meta: Included: guided tour, full lunch, wine, hotel transfers

items.title: Check-in at Avant Mar
items.body: A 38-key Leading Hotels property on Piperi Beach, just outside Naoussa. Expect a quiet pool, Cycladic minimalism, and the kind of attentive staff that anticipates rather than asks.

items.title: Dinner at Matsuhisa Paros
items.body: Nobu Matsuhisa's outpost lives at Avant Mar, so dinner is just downstairs. Expect the classic Matsuhisa hits — black cod, yellowtail jalapeño — done in a relaxed island setting.

days.title: Paros to Santorini
days.subtitle: A long Cycladic morning · ferry to the caldera · wine tour through volcanic vineyards
days.overview_summary: Morning at Cosme & Andronis Wellness · Ferry PAS → JTR · Wine Paths of Santorini · Check-in at Andronis Arcadia

items.title: Morning visit to Cosme, a Luxury Collection Resort
items.body: A look at one of Paros's newer design-forward properties — sister property to Parilio — for context if you're thinking about a future stay or a longer Paros leg.

items.title: Check-out at Avant Mar
items.body: Bags loaded. Driver waiting.

items.title: Lunch at Andronis Concept Wellness Resort
items.body: Lunch poolside before the ferry. Light Mediterranean menu, sea breeze, no rush.

items.title: Ferry Paros → Santorini
items.body: Forty-five minutes by catamaran into the caldera. Arrive Athinios Port at 2:10 PM. Crossings can be lively — sit toward the middle of the boat if it's a windy day.
items.meta: Booking confirmed · Show up 45 minutes early

items.title: Transfer · Santorini Port to Oia
items.body: Roughly an hour up the spine of the island, climbing as you go. The first caldera view from the road is one of the trip's quiet highlights.

items.title: Wine Paths of Santorini
items.body: A private sommelier-led tour through three of the island's most distinctive wineries — the volcanic terroir produces wines you can't find anywhere else. Tastings paired with local nibbles, scenic drives in between.
items.meta: Included: luxury private vehicle, three wineries, tastings, light bites

items.title: Check-in at Andronis Arcadia
items.body: Your home for the last two nights. 114 suites carved into the cliffs of Oia, private pool on the suite, Evexia Spa, and an in-house Beefbar.

items.title: Dinner at Andronis Concept
items.body: Sister property a short drive away, with one of the most striking pool-edge restaurants on the island. Property tour and dinner — the design alone is worth the visit.

days.title: A Day on the Water · Caldera Sunset
days.subtitle: Private cruise to the volcano and the colored beaches · drinks at Canaves · farewell at Pacman
days.overview_summary: Six-hour private cruise · Hot Springs, Red Beach, White Beach · Drinks at Canaves Epitome · Farewell dinner at Pacman

items.title: Private Cruise · Hot Springs, Red Beach, White Beach
items.body: Your private boat for the day. Three signature stops — the hot springs at the foot of the volcano, the dramatic Red Beach, and the quieter White Beach near Messa Pigadia. Lunch and wine on board. Crew handles everything; you swim and sun.
items.meta: Included: skipper, crew, fuel, expert guide, lunch, wine, towels, bottled water · Round-trip transfers from Andronis Arcadia

items.title: Drinks at Canaves Epitome
items.body: An hour at the Canaves flagship — a quick property look and a cocktail with one of the best caldera views from this side of the island.

items.title: Andronis properties walk · Farewell dinner at Pacman
items.body: A walk through the Andronis collection's various villas as the sun begins to set, then dinner at Pacman — the cliff-edge restaurant that closes the trip on its highest note. Bring a layer; the breeze picks up after sunset.

days.title: Departure
days.subtitle: One last caldera morning · home from JTR
days.overview_summary: Check-out from Andronis Arcadia · Transfer to Santorini Airport · Departure

items.title: Slow morning at Andronis Arcadia
items.body: Breakfast on the suite terrace if the weather cooperates. The pool is yours until pickup.

items.title: Check-out at Andronis Arcadia
items.body: Settle any incidentals. The concierge holds bags if you'd like a last walk through the village.

items.title: Transfer · Hotel to Santorini Airport (JTR)
items.body: Roughly 35 minutes from Oia to the airport, depending on Sunday traffic.

items.title: Departure
items.body: Onward connection to Athens or directly home, depending on your routing. Safe travels — and ευχαριστώ for a beautiful week.

stops.name: La Divina
stops.description: A new 12-suite hotel in a neoclassical mansion in Athens's historic center, once dedicated to Maria Callas. Stunning views of the Acropolis and Ancient Agora, walking distance to Plaka, and the kind of intimate scale that feels more like a private home than a hotel.

stops.name: Psarou Delight Villa · BlueVillas
stops.description: A private villa in the BlueVillas Luxury Concept collection, set above Psarou with a private pool, unobstructed sea views, and a dedicated concierge plus butler. VIP reservations, arrival transfers, and welcome delicacies are all included as part of the BlueVillas service.

stops.name: Avant Mar · Leading Hotels of the World
stops.description: A 38-key luxury resort on Paros's Piperi Beach, steps from Naoussa. Contemporary Cycladic design, a beautiful pool, a wellness area, and Matsuhisa Paros — Nobu Matsuhisa's only Greek outpost — on the property.

stops.name: Andronis Arcadia
stops.description: Member of the LEGEND Collection by Preferred Hotels. 114 suites and villas carved into the cliffs of Oia, with the Evexia Spa, Beefbar Santorini, and private pools. Bespoke service, serene caldera views, and one of the most reliably breathtaking sunsets in the world.

contacts.title: Important Contacts
contacts.intro: Keep this page handy. Reach out anytime and I will sort whatever comes up — and your local DMC team is always one text away on the ground.
contacts.send_off: Have the most wonderful trip — soak up every island, every sunset, and every glass of assyrtiko. Καλό ταξίδι!
